title: Methane Abatement Costs in the Oil and Gas Industry: Survey and Synthesis
abstract: There is growing recognition of the relative importance of anthropogenic emissions of methane as a contributor to global climate change. An important source of such emissions in some countries, including the United States, is the oil and gas (O&G) sector. This points to the importance of developing understanding of the marginal abatement cost functions for methane emissions reductions. Scholars have employed a diverse set of methodologies to estimate abatement costs, including engineering cost models, econometric analysis of natural gas markets, and statistical retrospective analysis of state-level regulation. We critically examine these approaches and synthesize their results. We find significant potential for low-cost methane abatement in the O&G sector in the United States and elsewhere, although claims of widespread negative abatement cost opportunities should be taken with a grain of salt. We also find that the potential for low-cost abatement is not without limit. Whereas it appears that cutting methane emissions in half would be relatively inexpensive, a sharp uptick in marginal abatement cost may occur when reductions exceed 60 to 80 percent below baseline levels. This threshold may change over time with technological advances in remote sensing, which can reduce abatement costs at various levels of ambition.
abstract_zh: 人们日益认识到，人为甲烷排放作为全球气候变化的一个成因，具有相对重要的地位。在包括美国在内的一些国家，油气（O&G）行业是此类排放的重要来源。这凸显了深入理解甲烷减排边际减排成本函数的重要性。学者们采用了多种方法来估计减排成本，包括工程成本模型、天然气市场的计量经济分析以及州级监管的统计回顾性分析。我们对这些方法进行了批判性考察，并综合了它们的结果。我们发现，美国及其他地区的油气行业存在显著的低成本甲烷减排潜力，但关于存在广泛负减排成本机会的说法应持审慎态度。我们还发现，低成本减排潜力并非没有上限。虽然将甲烷排放减半似乎相对廉价，但当减排幅度超过基准水平的60%至80%时，边际减排成本可能急剧上升。随着遥感技术的进步，这一阈值可能会随时间而变化，因为遥感技术能够在不同减排力度水平上降低减排成本。

title: The Relative Merits of Carbon Pricing Instruments: Taxes versus Trading
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy, 16: 1-21
abstract: There is widespread agreement among most economists that economy-wide carbon pricing will be a necessary (although not necessarily sufficient) component of any policy that can achieve meaningful and cost-effective CO2 reductions in large, complex economies. But there is less agreement about which of two carbon pricing instruments will be better. Some support carbon taxes, while others favor cap-and-trade. How do these two pricing approaches compare? In this survey and synthesis of theory and experience, I show that when carbon taxes and carbon cap-and-trade systems are designed in ways that make them truly comparable, their characteristics and outcomes are similar and, in some respects, fully equivalent. But the two approaches can perform quite differently along some specific dimensions, sometimes favoring taxes and sometimes cap-and-trade. The key differences in performance depend on details of program design. Indeed, what appears at first glance to be a dichotomous choice between two distinct instruments can turn out to be a choice of specific design elements along a policy continuum.
abstract_zh: 大多数经济学家普遍认为，在大型复杂经济体中，全经济范围的碳定价将是任何能够实现有意义且具有成本效益的二氧化碳减排政策的必要组成部分（尽管不一定是充分条件）。但对于两种碳定价工具孰优孰劣，则存在较大分歧。一些人支持碳税，另一些人则偏好总量控制与交易。这两种定价方式究竟如何比较？在这篇关于理论与实践的综述与综合中，我表明，当碳税与碳总量控制与交易体系的设计使二者真正可比时，它们的特征与结果是相似的，并且在某些方面是完全等价的。但这两种方式在某些具体维度上的表现可能差异很大，有时有利于碳税，有时则有利于总量控制与交易。表现上的关键差异取决于政策设计的细节。事实上，乍看起来似乎是在两种截然不同工具之间的二元选择，最终可能会变成沿着一个政策连续统选择具体设计要素的问题。

title: Keep climate policy focused on the social cost of carbon: A proposed shift away from the SCC is ill advised
The Future of U.S. Carbon-Pricing Policy
venue: Environmental and Energy Policy and the Economy, 1: 8-64
abstract: There is widespread agreement among economists -and a diverse set of other policy analyststhat at least in the long run, an economy-wide carbon pricing system will be an essential element of any national policy that can achieve meaningful reductions of CO2 emissions cost-effectively in the United States. There is less agreement, however, among economists and others in the policy community regarding the choice of specific carbon-pricing policy instrument, with some supporting carbon taxes and others favoring cap and trade mechanisms. This prompts two important questions. How do the two major approaches to carbon pricing compare on relevant dimensions, including but not limited to efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and distributional equity? And which of the two approaches is more likely to be adopted in the future in the United States? This paper addresses these questions by drawing on both normative and positive theories of policy instrument choice as they apply to U.S. climate change policy, and draws extensively on relevant empirical evidence. The paper concludes with a look at the path ahead, including an assessment of how the two carbon-pricing instruments can be made more politically acceptable.
abstract_zh: 经济学家之间（以及其他多样化的政策分析人士之间）普遍认为，至少从长期来看，全经济范围的碳定价体系将是任何能够以成本效益方式实现美国二氧化碳排放有意义减少的国家政策的基本要素。然而，经济学家及政策界其他人士在具体碳定价政策工具的选择上，分歧较大：一些人支持碳税，另一些人则赞成总量控制与交易机制。这引出了两个重要问题。两种主要的碳定价方式在相关维度上如何比较，包括但不限于效率、成本效益和分配公平？在这两种方式中，哪一种更有可能在未来被美国采纳？本文借鉴适用于美国气候变化政策的政策工具选择的规范理论与实证理论，并广泛运用了相关的经验证据，对这些问题进行了探讨。本文最后展望了前进的道路，包括评估如何使这两种碳定价工具在政治上更容易被接受。

title: Double Counting and the Paris Agreement Rulebook
Economics of the Environment: Selected Readings, Seventh Edition
Linking Heterogeneous Climate Policies (Consistent with the Paris Agreement)
abstract: The Paris Agreement to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change has achieved one of two key necessary conditions for ultimate success—a broad base of participation among the countries of the world. But another key necessary condition has yet to be achieved—adequate collective ambition of the individual nationally determined contributions. How can the climate negotiators provide a structure that will include incentives to increase ambition over time? An important part of the answer can be international linkage of regional, national, and sub-national policies, that is, formal recognition of emission reductions undertaken in another jurisdiction for the purpose of meeting a Party’s own mitigation objectives. A central challenge is how to facilitate such linkage in the context of the very great heterogeneity that characterizes climate policies along five dimensions: type of policy instrument, level of government jurisdiction, status of that jurisdiction under the Paris Agreement, nature of the policy instrument’s target, and the nature along several dimensions of each Party’s Nationally Determined Contribution. We consider such heterogeneity among policies, and identify which linkages of various combinations of characteristics are feasible; of these, which are most promising; and what accounting mechanisms would make the operation of respective linkages consistent with the Paris Agreement.
abstract_zh: 《联合国气候变化框架公约》下的《巴黎协定》已实现了最终取得成功的两项关键必要条件之一——世界各国的广泛参与。但另一项关键必要条件尚未实现，即各国自主决定的贡献（NDC）具有充分的集体雄心。气候谈判者如何构建一种结构，以包含随时间推移提高雄心的激励？答案的一个重要部分，可以是地区、国家和次国家政策之间的国际链接，即正式承认在另一司法管辖区所实现的减排，可用于实现一方自身的减排目标。一个核心挑战在于，如何在气候政策于五个维度上表现出极大异质性的背景下促进此类链接：政策工具的类型、政府管辖层级、该管辖区在《巴黎协定》下的地位、政策工具目标的性质，以及每一缔约方自主决定贡献在多个维度上的性质。我们考虑了政策之间的此类异质性，识别了各种特征组合下哪些链接是可行的；在这些链接中，哪些最具前景；以及哪些核算机制能够使相应的链接运作与《巴黎协定》保持一致。

title: Policy Evolution Under the Clean Air Act
International Climate Change Policy
abstract: International cooperation to address the threat of climate change has become more institutionally diverse over the past decade, reflecting multiple scales of governance and the growing inclusion of climate change issues in other policy arenas. Cooperation under the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change has continued to evolve from the 1997 Kyoto Protocol to the 2015 Paris Agreement, while other governmental and private sector international fora for cooperation have arisen. As the level of activity in international cooperation on climate change mitigation has increased, so too has the related scholarly literature. In this review, we synthesize the literature on international climate change cooperation and identify key policy implications, as well as those findings most relevant for the research community. Our scope includes critical evaluation of the organization and implementation of agreements and instruments, retrospective analysis of cooperative efforts, and explanations of successes and failures.
abstract_zh: 过去十年间，应对气候变化威胁的国际合作在制度上日益多样化，这反映了治理的多层次性，以及气候变化问题在其他政策领域中日益增长的纳入。《联合国气候变化框架公约》下的合作不断演进，从1997年的《京都议定书》发展到2015年的《巴黎协定》，同时，其他政府间和私营部门的国际合作论坛也相继出现。随着气候变化减缓国际合作活动水平的提高，相关的学术文献也随之增多。在本综述中，我们对国际气候变化合作的文献进行了综合，并指出了关键的政策含义，以及与研究界最为相关的发现。我们的范围包括：对协议与工具的组织和实施进行批判性评估，对合作努力的回顾性分析，以及对成功与失败的解释。

title: Linking Climate Policies to Advance Global Mitigation
abstract: The November 2017 negotiations in Bonn, Germany, under the auspices of the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) validated that the Paris Agreement has met one of two necessary conditions for success. By achieving broad participation, including 195 countries, accounting for 99% of global greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions (1), the agreement dramatically improves on the 14% of global emissions associated with countries acting under the Kyoto Protocol (2), the international agreement it will replace in 2020. But the second necessary condition, adequate collective ambition of the nationally determined contributions (NDCs) that countries have individually pledged, has not been met. One promising approach to incentivize countries to increase ambition over time is to link different climate policies, such that emission reductions in one jurisdiction can be counted toward mitigation commitments of another jurisdiction. Drawing on our research and our experiences in Bonn, we explore options and challenges for facilitating such linkages in light of the considerable heterogeneity that is likely to characterize regional, national, and subnational policy efforts.
abstract_zh: 2017年11月，在德国波恩，《联合国气候变化框架公约》（UNFCCC）主持下的谈判证实，《巴黎协定》已满足了成功所需的两项必要条件之一。通过实现广泛的参与（包括195个国家，占全球温室气体排放的99%）（1），该协定极大地改进了由《京都议定书》下行动国家所对应的全球排放比例（仅为14%）（2），而《京都议定书》将于2020年被该协定取代。然而，第二项必要条件，即各国单独承诺的国家自主贡献（NDC）具有充分的集体雄心，尚未得到满足。激励各国随时间推移提高雄心的一种前景广阔的途径，是将不同的气候政策相互链接，使一个管辖区的减排量可以计入另一个管辖区的减缓承诺中。基于我们的研究和在波恩的经历，鉴于地区、国家和次国家政策努力很可能呈现出的巨大异质性，我们探讨了促进此类链接的选项与挑战。

title: Assessing the Energy-Efficiency Gap
abstract: Energy-efficient technologies offer considerable promise for reducing the financial costs and environmental damages associated with energy use, but these technologies appear not to be adopted by consumers and businesses to the degree that would apparently be justified, even on a purely financial basis. We present two complementary frameworks for understanding this so-called “energy paradox” or “energy-efficiency gap.” First, we build on the previous literature by dividing potential explanations for the energy-efficiency gap into three categories: market failures, behavioral anomalies, and model and measurement errors. Second, we posit that it is useful to think in terms of the fundamental elements of cost-minimizing energy-efficiency decisions. This provides a decomposition that organizes thinking around four questions. First, are product offerings and pricing economically efficient? Second, are energy operating costs inefficiently priced and/or understood? Third, are product choices cost-minimizing in present value terms? Fourth, do other costs inhibit more energy-efficient decisions? We review empirical evidence on these questions, with an emphasis on recent advances, and offer suggestions for future research.
abstract_zh: 能效技术在降低与能源使用相关的财务成本和环境损害方面具有相当大的前景，然而，即使仅从纯粹的财务角度看，这些技术似乎也未被消费者和企业采用到应有的程度。我们提出了两个互为补充的框架，用以理解这种所谓的“能源悖论”或“能效差距”。第一，我们在既有文献的基础上，将能效差距的潜在解释划分为三类：市场失灵、行为异常以及模型与测量误差。第二，我们认为，从成本最小化的节能决策的基本要素出发进行思考是有益的。这提供了一种分解方法，围绕四个问题组织思考。第一，产品供给与定价是否在经济上有效率？第二，能源运营成本的定价和/或认知是否低效？第三，从现值角度看，产品选择是否实现了成本最小化？第四，其他成本是否阻碍了更为节能的决策？我们回顾了关于这些问题的实证证据，重点关注近期进展，并提出了未来研究的建议。

title: Lessons Learned from Three Decades of Experience with Cap and Trade
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy, 11(1): 59-79
abstract: This article presents an overview of the design and performance of seven major emissions trading programs that have been implemented over the past 30 years and identifies a number of important lessons for future applications of this important environmental policy instrument. A brief discussion of several other proposed or implemented emissions trading programs is also included.
abstract_zh: 本文概述了过去30年间实施的七个主要排放交易项目的设计与绩效，并指出了对未来应用这一重要环境政策工具的若干重要经验教训。文中还简要讨论了其他一些已提出或已实施的排放交易项目。

title: Terroir in the New World: Hedonic Estimation of Vineyard Sale Prices in California
abstract: In the Old-World vineyards of Europe, a key concept that plays an important role in the production and appreciation of wines isterroir, which refers to the special characteristics of a place that impart unique qualities to the wine produced. We examine whetherterroirmatters in the New-World wines produced in California's Napa and Sonoma Counties by conducting a hedonic price analysis of vineyard sales over the period 1991 to 2007 to determine the relative effects on vineyard sales prices of designated appellations versus biophysical site attributes commonly associated withterroir, such as slope, aspect, elevation, and climate. Because vineyards that are sold are not necessarily representative of the universe of vineyards, we employ Heckman's two-stage econometric approach to control for possible sample-selection bias. We find that intrinsic site attributes and designated appellations influence vineyard prices, although our results are stronger and more consistent with regard to the influence of appellations. This finding indicates thatterroirmatters economically, even if the designated appellations have relatively less connection in reality withterroir. (JEL Classifications: C2, Q11)
abstract_zh: 在欧洲的旧世界葡萄园中，一个在葡萄酒的生产与欣赏中发挥重要作用的关键概念是风土（terroir），它指的是某一地方的特殊属性，赋予所产葡萄酒独特的品质。我们通过对1991年至2007年间的葡萄园交易进行特征价格分析，考察风土在加利福尼亚纳帕县和索诺玛县生产的新世界葡萄酒中是否重要，以确定指定产区（appellation）与通常与风土相关的生物物理场地属性（如坡度、朝向、海拔和气候）对葡萄园交易价格的相对影响。由于出售的葡萄园不一定能代表全部葡萄园，我们采用赫克曼两阶段计量方法来控制可能存在的样本选择偏误。我们发现，场地的内在属性和指定产区都会影响葡萄园价格，不过，我们的结果在指定产区的影响方面更为稳健、也更为一致。这一发现表明，风土在经济上是重要的，即便指定产区在现实中与风土的关联相对较弱。（JEL分类：C2, Q11）

title: The Design of Environmental Markets: What Have We Learned From Experience With Cap and Trade?
abstract: This article reviews the design of environmental markets for pollution control over the past 30 years, and identifies key market-design lessons for future applications. The focus is on a subset of the cap-and-trade systems that have been implemented, planned, or proposed around the world. Three criteria led us to the selection of systems for review. First, among the broader class of tradable permit systems, our focus is exclusively on cap-and-trade mechanisms, thereby excluding emission-reduction-credit or offset programmes. Second, among cap-and-trade mechanisms, we examine only those that target pollution abatement, and so we do not include applications to natural resource management, such as individual transferable quota systems used to regulate fisheries. Third, we focus on the most prominent applications—those that are particularly important environmentally, economically, or both.
abstract_zh: 本文回顾了过去30年间污染控制环境市场的设计，并指出了未来应用的关键市场设计经验。重点关注的是在全球范围内已经实施、规划或提出的总量控制与交易体系中的一个子集。我们依据三条标准选定了所回顾的体系。第一，在更广泛的可交易许可体系中，我们只关注总量控制与交易机制，因而排除了减排信用或抵消项目。第二，在总量控制与交易机制中，我们只考察针对污染减排的机制，因而不包括用于自然资源管理的应用，例如用于渔业监管的个体可转让配额制度。第三，我们侧重于最为突出的应用，即在环境、经济或两者方面尤为重要的应用。

title: The Evolution of Environmental Economics: A View from the Inside
abstract: This essay provides one economist’s perspective on the two-decade evolution of the field of environmental economics, by tracing it through personal reflections on the professional path that has led to my research and writing. Also, the article summarizes the highlights of some of my research and writing during this period.
abstract_zh: 本文通过追溯引导我走向研究与写作的职业历程中的个人思考，从一位经济学家的视角，描绘了环境经济学这一领域二十年来的演变。文章还概述了我在此期间的一些研究与写作的亮点。

title: Reforming the IPCC’s Assessment of Climate Change Economics
abstract: The Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) is broadly viewed as the world’s most legitimate scientific assessment body that periodically assesses the economics of climate change (among many other topics) for policy audiences. However, growing procedural inefficiencies and limitations to substantive coverage have made the IPCC an increasingly unattractive forum for the most qualified climate economists. Drawing on our observations and personal experience working on the most recent IPCC report, published last year, we propose four reforms to the IPCC’s process that we believe will lower the cost for volunteering as an IPCC author: improving interactions between governments and academics, making IPCC operations more efficient, clarifying and strengthening conflict of interest rules, and expanding outreach. We also propose three reforms to the IPCC’s substantive coverage to clarify the IPCC’s role and to make participation as an author more intellectually rewarding: complementing the IPCC with other initiatives, improving the integration of economics with other disciplines, and providing complete data for policymakers to make decisions. Despite the distinct characteristics of the IPCC that create challenges for authors unlike those in any other review body, we continue to believe in the importance of the IPCC for providing the most visible line of public communication between the scholarly community and policymakers.
abstract_zh: 政府间气候变化专门委员会（IPCC）被广泛视为世界上最具合法性的科学评估机构，它定期为政策受众评估气候变化的经济学（以及众多其他主题）。然而，日益增长的程序低效和实质性覆盖的局限，使得IPCC对于最合格的气候经济学家而言，日益缺乏吸引力。基于我们在去年发布的最新一期IPCC报告中工作的观察和个人经验，我们提出了四项对IPCC流程的改革建议，我们相信这些改革将降低担任IPCC作者的志愿成本：改善政府与学界之间的互动，提高IPCC运作的效率，明确并加强利益冲突规则，以及扩大外展。我们还提出了三项关于IPCC实质性覆盖范围的改革建议，以厘清IPCC的角色，并使担任作者的参与更具智识上的回报：以其他倡议补充IPCC，改善经济学与其他学科的融合，以及为决策者提供完整的数据。尽管IPCC的独特性质给其作者带来了与任何其他评审机构都不同的挑战，我们仍然认为，IPCC对于在学术界与决策者之间提供最为醒目的公共沟通渠道，依然至关重要。

title: Facilitating Linkage of Climate Policies through the Paris Outcome
abstract: The Durban Platform for Enhanced Action negotiations are likely to lead to a Paris outcome that embodies a hybrid climate policy architecture, combining top-down elements, such as for monitoring, reporting, and verification, with bottom-up elements, including ‘Intended Nationally Determined Contributions’ from participating countries, detailing plans to reduce emissions, based on national circumstances. For such a system to be cost-effective – and thus more likely to embody greater ambition – a key feature will be linkages among regional, national, and sub-national climate policies. By linkage, we mean formal recognition by a mitigation programme in one jurisdiction of emission reductions undertaken in another jurisdiction for the purposes of complying with the first jurisdiction's requirements. The Paris outcome could play at least four different roles with respect to linkage of heterogeneous policy instruments. First, it could discourage linkage, either by not allowing countries to count international transfers toward their mitigation contributions, or by limiting the number or types of transferred units that can be counted for compliance purposes. Second, it could be silent on the topic of linkage, creating legal and regulatory uncertainty about whether international transfers are allowed. Third, it could expressly authorize linkage but not provide any further details about how linkage should occur, leaving it to future United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change negotiating sessions to work out the details or to national governments to develop bilateral or multilateral linkage arrangements. Finally, the Paris outcome could establish institutional arrangements and rules that facilitate and promote linkage. We examine how a future international policy architecture could help facilitate the growth and operation of a robust system of international linkages. Several design elements merit serious consideration for inclusion in the Paris outcome, either in the core agreement or by establishing a process for subsequent international elaboration. At the same time, including detailed linkage rules in the core agreement is not desirable because this could make it difficult for rules to evolve in light of experience. Policy relevanceThese findings have implications for the efficient and effective design of an international climate policy architecture by detailing the role that linkage can play in supporting heterogeneous climate policies at the regional, national, and sub-national levels.
abstract_zh: 德班加强行动平台谈判很可能会形成一个巴黎成果，该成果体现出一种混合型气候政策架构，将自上而下的要素（例如监测、报告与核查）与自下而上的要素相结合，后者包括参与国提交的“拟定国家自主贡献”，详述各国基于本国国情的减排计划。要使这样一个体系具有成本效益，从而更有可能体现更大的雄心，一个关键特征将是地区、国家和次国家气候政策之间的链接。所谓链接，是指一个管辖区的减排机制，正式承认另一个管辖区所实现的减排量，并将其用于满足第一个管辖区的要求。巴黎成果可以在异质性政策工具的链接方面发挥至少四种不同的作用。第一，它可能阻碍链接，例如不允许各国将国际转让计入其减缓贡献，或限制可计入合规目的的转让单位的数量或类型。第二，它可能对链接问题保持沉默，从而使国际转让是否被允许存在法律和监管上的不确定性。第三，它可能明确授权链接，但不对链接应如何进行提供进一步的细节，而将细节留待未来《联合国气候变化框架公约》的谈判会议去厘定，或留给各国政府去制定双边或多边的链接安排。最后，巴黎成果可以建立促进并推动链接的制度安排与规则。我们探讨了未来的国际政策架构如何有助于促进一个稳健的国际链接体系的发展与运行。若干设计要素值得认真考虑，以纳入巴黎成果之中，无论是纳入核心协定，还是通过设立后续国际细化的程序。同时，在核心协定中纳入详细的链接规则并不可取，因为这可能使规则难以根据经验加以调整。政策相关性：这些发现通过阐明链接在支持地区、国家和次国家异质性气候政策方面所能发挥的作用，对国际气候政策架构的高效有效设计具有启示意义。

title: From the Science to the Economics and Politics of Climate Change: An Introduction
venue: In Our World and Us: How Our Environment and Our Societies Will Change (ed. K. Barysch), Allianz Group

title: International Cooperation: Agreements and Instruments
venue: In Climate Change 2014: Mitigation of Climate Change. IPCC Fifth Assessment Report, Working Group III, Chapter 13, Cambridge University Press

title: Linkage of Greenhouse Gas Emissions Trading Systems: Learning from Experience
abstract: The last ten years have seen the growth of linkages between many of the world's cap-and-trade systems for GHGs, both directly between systems, and indirectly via connections to credit systems such as the Clean Development Mechanism. If nations have tried to act in their own self-interest, this proliferation of linkages implies that for many nations, the expected benefits of linkage outweighed expected costs. In this article, we draw on the past decade of experience with carbon markets to examine why systems have demonstrated this revealed preference for linking. Linkage is a multi-faceted policy decision that can be used by political jurisdictions to achieve a variety of objectives, and we find qualitative evidence that many economic, political, and strategic factors – ranging from geographic proximity to integrity of emissions reductions – influence the decision to link. We also identify some potentially important effects of linkage, such as loss of control over domestic carbon policies, which do not appear to have deterred real-world decisions to link. Policy relevanceThese findings have implications for the future role that decentralized linkages may play in international climate policy architecture. The Kyoto Protocol has entered what is probably its final commitment period, covering only a small fraction of global GHG emissions. Under the Durban Platform for Enhanced Action, negotiators may now gravitate toward a hybrid system, combining top-down elements for establishing targets with bottom-up elements of pledge-and-review tied to national policies and actions. The incentives for linking these national policies are likely to continue to produce direct connections among regional, national, and sub-national cap-and-trade systems. The growing network of decentralized, direct linkages among these systems may turn out to be a key part of a future hybrid climate policy architecture.
abstract_zh: 过去十年间，世界上许多温室气体总量控制与交易体系之间的链接有所增长，既包括体系之间的直接链接，也包括通过与清洁发展机制等信用体系的连接而形成的间接链接。如果各国都试图从自身利益出发行事，那么这种链接的激增意味着，对许多国家而言，链接的预期收益超过了预期成本。在本文中，我们借鉴过去十年碳市场的经验，考察了为何这些体系表现出这种显示性的链接偏好。链接是一项多层面的政策决策，政治管辖区可以借此实现各种目标，我们发现，许多经济、政治和战略因素（从地理邻近性到减排的完整性）都影响着链接的决策，这些定性证据是明确的。我们还指出了链接可能产生的一些潜在重要影响，例如对国内碳政策控制权的丧失，但这些影响似乎并未阻止现实世界中的链接决策。政策相关性：这些发现对分散化链接在未来国际气候政策架构中可能发挥的作用具有启示意义。《京都议定书》已进入其或许是最后的承诺期，所覆盖的全球温室气体排放仅占一小部分。在德班加强行动平台下，谈判者现在可能倾向于混合体系，将确立目标的自上而下要素，与同国家政策和行动相联系的自下而上的承诺与审议要素相结合。链接这些国家政策的激励，很可能会继续推动地区、国家和次国家总量控制与交易体系之间产生直接连接。这些体系之间日益增长的分散化直接链接网络，可能最终成为未来混合型气候政策架构的关键组成部分。

title: Linkage of Regional, National, and Sub-National Policies in a Future International Climate Agreement
venue: In Towards a Workable and Effective Climate Regime, Centre for Economic Policy Research

title: The IPCC at a Crossroads: Opportunities for Reform
abstract: The Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) has proven its value as an institution for large-scale scientific collaboration to synthesize and assess large volumes of climate research for use by policy-makers, as well as for establishing credibility of findings among diverse national governments. But the IPCC has received considerable criticism of both its substance and process. The new IPCC leadership to be elected in October could help guide the IPCC to a clear, shared understanding of future objectives and could shape procedural reforms. We identify key opportunities for reform by addressing two related questions: Is the IPCC doing the right things? Is the IPCC doing things right?
abstract_zh: 政府间气候变化专门委员会（IPCC）已证明，其作为大规模科学合作机构的价值：它为政策制定者综合和评估海量的气候研究成果，同时在多样化的各国政府之间建立了研究结论的可信度。然而，IPCC在实质内容和程序两方面都受到了相当多的批评。将于10月选出的IPCC新领导层，可能有助于引导IPCC形成对未来目标的清晰且共同的理解，并可能塑造程序改革。我们通过回答两个相关问题，确定了改革的关键机遇：IPCC是否在做正确的事？IPCC是否在正确地做事？

title: An Economic Perspective on the EPA’s Clean Power Plan
abstract: In June, the Obama Administration unveiled its proposal for a Clean Power Plan, which it estimates would reduce carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions from existing U.S. power plants 30% below 2005 levels by 2030. Power plant emissions have declined substantially since 2005, so the plan is seeking reductions of about 18% from current levels. Electricity generation accounts for about 40% of U.S. CO2 emissions. We examine whether the plan will achieve its intended emissions reductions, and how it can do so in the most cost-effective manner, highlighting the role of cross-state coordination in lowering compliance costs.
abstract_zh: 6月，奥巴马政府公布了其《清洁电力计划》提案，估计该计划将使现有美国发电厂的二氧化碳（CO2）排放相较2005年水平在2030年降低30%。自2005年以来，发电厂排放已大幅下降，因此该计划所寻求的是相对于当前水平约18%的减排。发电约占美国二氧化碳排放的40%。我们考察该计划能否实现其预期的减排目标，以及如何以最具成本效益的方式实现，并强调州际协调在降低合规成本中的作用。

title: An Assessment of the Energy-Efficiency Gap and its Implications for Climate-Change Policy
abstract: Improving end-use energy efficiency — that is, the energy-efficiency of individuals, households, and firms as they consume energy — is often cited as an important element in efforts to reduce greenhouse-gas (GHG) emissions. Arguments for improving energy efficiency usually rely on the idea that energy-efficient technologies will save end users money over time and thereby provide low-cost or no-cost options for reducing GHG emissions. However, some research suggests that energy-efficient technologies appear not to be adopted by consumers and businesses to the degree that would seem justified, even on a purely financial basis. We review in this paper the evidence for a range of explanations for this apparent “energy-efficiency gap.” We find most explanations are grounded in sound economic theory, but the strength of empirical support for these explanations varies widely. Retrospective program evaluations suggest the cost of GHG abatement varies considerably across different energy-efficiency investments and can diverge substantially from the predictions of prospective models. Findings from research on the energy-efficiency gap could help policy makers generate social and private benefits from accelerating the diffusion of energy-efficient technologies — including reduction of GHG emissions.
abstract_zh: 改善终端用能效率，即个人、家庭和企业在消费能源时的能源效率，常被视为减少温室气体（GHG）排放努力中的一项重要内容。提高能效的论据通常依赖于这样一种观点：高能效技术会随着时间推移为终端用户节省资金，从而为减少温室气体排放提供低成本甚至零成本的选择。然而，一些研究表明，即使仅从纯粹的财务角度看，高能效技术似乎也未被消费者和企业采用到应有的程度。本文回顾了对这一明显的“能效差距”的一系列解释的证据。我们发现，大多数解释都以健全的经济理论为基础，但这些解释的实证支持力度差异很大。回顾性项目评估表明，不同能效投资的温室气体减排成本差异相当大，并且可能与前瞻性模型的预测存在显著偏离。关于能效差距的研究成果，有助于政策制定者加速能效技术的扩散，从而获得社会和私人收益，包括减少温室气体排放。

title: Facilitating Linkage of Heterogeneous Regional, National, and Sub-National Climate Policies Through a Future International Agreement
venue: Harvard Project on Climate Agreements discussion paper [F-35]
abstract: Negotiations pursuant to the Durban Platform for Enhanced Action appear likely to lead to a 2015 Paris agreement that embodies a hybrid climate policy architecture, combining top-down elements, such as for monitoring, reporting, and verification, with bottom-up elements, including “nationally determined contributions” from each participating country, detailing what it intends to do to reduce emissions, based on its national circumstances. For such a system to be cost-effective — and thus more likely to achieve significant global emissions reductions — a key feature will be linkages among regional, national, and sub-national climate policies. By linkage, we mean a formal recognition by a greenhouse gas mitigation program in one jurisdiction (a regional, national, or sub-national government) of emission reductions undertaken in another jurisdiction for purposes of complying with the first jurisdiction’s mitigation program. We examine how a future international policy architecture could help facilitate the growth and operation of a robust system of international linkages of regional, national, and sub-national policies. Several design elements merit serious consideration for inclusion in the Paris agreement, either directly or by establishing a process for subsequent international elaboration. At the same time, including detailed linkage rules in the core agreement is not desirable because this could make it difficult for rules to evolve in light of experience.
abstract_zh: 德班加强行动平台下的谈判，很可能会促成2015年的巴黎协定，该协定体现了一种混合型气候政策架构，将自上而下的要素（例如监测、报告与核查）与自下而上的要素相结合，后者包括每个参与国家的“国家自主贡献”，详述其基于本国国情拟采取的减排措施。要使这样一个体系具有成本效益，从而更有可能实现显著的全球减排，一个关键特征将是地区、国家和次国家气候政策之间的链接。所谓链接，是指一个管辖区（地区、国家或次国家政府）的温室气体减缓计划，正式承认另一管辖区所实现的减排，并将其用于满足第一管辖区减缓计划的要求。我们探讨了未来的国际政策架构如何有助于促进地区、国家和次国家政策之间稳健的国际链接体系的发展与运行。若干设计要素值得认真考虑，无论是直接纳入巴黎协定，还是通过设立后续国际细化的程序。同时，在核心协定中纳入详细的链接规则并不可取，因为这可能使规则难以根据经验加以调整。

title: Designing the Post-Kyoto Climate Regime
venue: In A New Global Covenant: Protection without Protectionism, Columbia University Press
abstract: The Kyoto Protocol to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) marked the first meaningful attempt by the community of nations to curb greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions. This agreement, though a significant first step, is not sufficient for the longer-term task ahead. Whether one thinks the Kyoto Protocol was a good first step or a bad first step, everyone agrees that a second step is required. This chapter identifies some key principles and promising policy architectures for the post-Kyoto period. A credible global climate change agreement must be: equitable; cost-effective; able to facilitate significant technological change and technology transfer; consistent with the international trade regime; practical, in the sense that it builds where possible on existing institutions and practices; attentive to short-term achievements, as well as medium-term consequences and long-term goals; and realistic. The chapter also considers four potential frameworks for a post-Kyoto agreement. The first calls for emissions caps established using a set of formulas that assign quantitative emissions limits to countries through 2100. A second potential framework would instead rely on a system of linked international agreements that separately address mitigation in various sectors and gases. A third architecture would consist of harmonized domestic taxes on emissions of GHGs from all sources. A fourth architecture links national and regional tradable permit systems only indirectly, through the global Clean Development Mechanism (CDM) established by the Protocol.
abstract_zh: 《联合国气候变化框架公约》的《京都议定书》标志着各国首次就遏制温室气体排放作出的有意义的尝试。这一协定虽然是重要的第一步，但对于未来更长期的任务而言并不充分。无论人们认为《京都议定书》是一个良好的第一步还是糟糕的第一步，所有人都同意，第二步是必需的。本章确定了后京都时期的一些关键原则和有前景的政策架构。一项可信的全球气候变化协定必须做到：公平；具有成本效益；能够促进重大技术变革与技术转让；与国际贸易体制相一致；务实，即尽可能建立在现有制度与做法之上；既关注短期成就，也关注中期后果和长期目标；并且切合实际。本章还考虑了后京都协定的四种潜在框架。第一种框架要求，通过一套公式设定排放上限，为各国分配至2100年的定量排放限额。第二种潜在框架则依赖于一个由相互链接的国际协定组成的体系，分别针对不同部门和气体的减排问题作出规定。第三种架构由对所有来源温室气体排放征收统一的国内税构成。第四种架构则仅通过《议定书》所设立的全球清洁发展机制（CDM），间接地链接国家和区域可交易许可体系。

title: Economics of Climate Change and Environmental Policy: Selected Papers of Robert N. Stavins, 2000-2011
Navigating a Two-Way Street Between Academia and the Policy World
venue: In Economics of Climate Change and Environmental Policy: Selected Papers of Robert N. Stavins, 2000-2011, Edward Elgar Publishing

title: Post-Durban Climate Policy Architecture Based on Linkage of Cap-and-Trade Systems
abstract: The outcome of the December 2011 United Nations climate negotiations in Durban, South Africa, provides an important new opportunity to move toward an international climate policy architecture that is capable of delivering broad international participation and significant global CO2 emissions reductions at reasonable cost. We evaluate one important component of potential climate policy architecture for the post-Durban era: links among independent tradable permit systems for greenhouse gases. Because linkage reduces the cost of achieving given targets, there is tremendous pressure to link existing and planned cap-and-trade systems, and in fact, a number of links already or will soon exist. We draw on recent political and economic experience with linkage to evaluate potential roles that linkage may play in post-Durban international climate policy, both in a near-term, de facto architecture of indirect links between regional, national, and sub-national cap-and-trade systems, and in longer-term, more comprehensive bottom-up architecture of direct links. Although linkage will certainly help to reduce long-term abatement costs, it may also serve as an effective mechanism for building institutional and political structure to support a future climate agreement.
abstract_zh: 2011年12月在南非德班举行的联合国气候谈判的结果，为朝着一种能够实现广泛国际参与并以合理成本实现全球二氧化碳显著减排的国际气候政策架构迈进，提供了一个重要的新机遇。我们评估了后德班时代潜在气候政策架构的一个重要组成部分：温室气体独立可交易许可体系之间的链接。由于链接能够降低实现既定目标的成本，因此现有和规划中的总量控制与交易体系之间存在巨大的链接压力，事实上，已有或即将出现若干链接。我们借鉴近期在链接方面的政治和经济经验，评估链接在后德班国际气候政策中可能发挥的潜在作用，既包括近期事实上的架构，即地区、国家和次国家总量控制与交易体系之间的间接链接，也包括长期而更为全面的、由自下而上的直接链接构成的架构。尽管链接无疑将有助于降低长期减排成本，但它也可能成为建立制度和政治结构的有效机制，以支持未来的气候协定。

title: The SO2 Allowance Trading System: The Ironic History of a Grand Policy Experiment
An Unambiguous Consequence of the Durban Climate Talks
venue: Review of Environment, Energy, and Economics: 1-4
abstract: One of the major outcomes of the Durban Climate Conference in 2011 was the “Durban Platform for Enhanced Action” - a non-binding agreement to forge a new treaty by 2015 that will bring all countries under the same legal regime by 2020. This article will explain why the “Durban Platform for Enhanced Action” has opened an important window in climate talks.
abstract_zh: 2011年德班气候大会的主要成果之一是“德班加强行动平台”，这是一项不具约束力的协议，旨在于2015年前达成一项新条约，使所有国家在2020年前纳入同一法律制度。本文将解释为何“德班加强行动平台”在气候谈判中开辟了一个重要的窗口。

title: Climate Negotiators Create an Opportunity for Scholars
abstract: The 1992 United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) launched a process to confront risks posed by global climate change. It has led to a dichotomy between countries with serious emission-reduction responsibilities and others with no responsibilities whatsoever. This has prevented progress, but recent talks suggest the prospect for a better way forward and an openness to outside-the-box thinking. Scholars and practitioners have a new opportunity to contribute innovative proposals for a future international climate policy architecture.
abstract_zh: 1992年《联合国气候变化框架公约》（UNFCCC）启动了应对全球气候变化风险的进程。该进程导致各国被划分为两类：一类承担严格的减排责任，另一类则完全不承担任何责任。这种二分法阻碍了进展，但近期的谈判表明，一条更好的前进道路已现出前景，各方对跳出既有框架的思考也更加开放。学者与实践者迎来了新的机遇，可以为未来的国际气候政策架构贡献创新性方案。

title: Economics of the Environment: Selected Readings (Fourth, Fifth, and Sixth Editions)
Interactions between State and Federal Climate Change Policies
venue: In The Design and Implementation of U.S. Climate Policy, NBER / University of Chicago Press
abstract: Federal action addressing climate change is likely to emerge either through new legislation or via the U.S. EPA's authority under the Clean Air Act. The prospect of federal action raises important questions regarding the interconnections between federal efforts and state-level climate policy developments. In the presence of federal policies, to what extent will state efforts be cost-effective? How does the co-existence of state-and federal-level policies affect the ability of state efforts to achieve emissions reductions? This paper addresses these questions. We find that state-level policy in the presence of a federal policy can be beneficial or problematic, depending on the nature of the overlap between the two systems, the relative stringency of the efforts, and the types of policy instruments engaged. When the federal policy sets limits on aggregate emissions quantities, or allows manufacturers or facilities to average performance across states, the emission reductions accomplished by a subset of U.S. states may reduce pressure on the constraints posed by the federal policy, thereby freeing facilities or manufacturers to increase emissions in other states. This leads to serious "emissions leakage" and a loss of cost-effectiveness at the national level. In contrast, when the federal policy sets prices for emissions or does not allow manufactures to average performance across states, these difficulties are usually avoided. Even in circumstances involving problematic interactions, there may be other attractions of state-level climate policy. We evaluate a number of arguments that have been made to support state-level climate policy in the presence of federal policies, even when problematic interactions arise.
abstract_zh: 应对气候变化的联邦行动，很可能通过新立法或美国环保署（EPA）依据《清洁空气法》所享有的权限而出现。联邦行动的前景引出了一些重要问题：联邦层面的努力与州级气候政策进展之间存在怎样的相互关联？在存在联邦政策的情况下，州级努力在多大程度上具有成本效益？州级政策与联邦级政策并存，如何影响州级努力实现减排的能力？本文探讨了这些问题。我们发现，在存在联邦政策的情况下，州级政策可能有益，也可能带来问题，这取决于两套体系之间交叠的性质、各自的严格程度以及所采用的政策工具类型。当联邦政策对排放总量设定上限，或允许制造商或设施在各州之间平均分摊绩效时，部分美国州实现的减排可能会减轻联邦政策约束所带来的压力，从而使设施或制造商得以在其他州增加排放。这将导致严重的“排放泄漏”，并造成全国层面成本效益的损失。相反，当联邦政策对排放设定价格，或不允许制造商在各州之间平均分摊绩效时，这些困难通常可以避免。即便在存在问题性互动的情形下，州级气候政策仍可能具有其他吸引力。我们评估了若干为存在联邦政策时的州级气候政策提供支持的论点，包括在出现问题性互动的情况下依然成立的论点。

title: The Promise and Problems of Pricing Carbon: Theory and Experience
abstract: Because of the global commons nature of climate change, international cooperation among nations will likely be necessary for meaningful action at the global level. At the same time, it will inevitably be up to the actions of sovereign nations to put in place policies that bring about meaningful reductions in the emissions of greenhouse gases. Due to the ubiquity and diversity of emissions of greenhouse gases in most economies, as well as the variation in abatement costs among individual sources, conventional environmental policy approaches, such as uniform technology and performance standards, are unlikely to be sufficient to the task. Therefore, attention has increasingly turned to market-based instruments in the form of carbon-pricing mechanisms. We examine the opportunities and challenges associated with the major options for carbon pricing—carbon taxes, cap-and-trade, emission reduction credits, clean energy standards, and fossil fuel subsidy reductions—and provide a review of the experiences, drawn primarily from developed countries, in implementing these instruments. Our summary of relevant theory and survey of experience from industrialized nations may be helpful to those who wish to examine the potential applicability of carbon pricing in the context of developing countries.
abstract_zh: 由于气候变化具有全球公共品的性质，各国之间的国际合作很可能是全球层面取得实质性行动的必要条件。与此同时，最终还要由各主权国家自行出台政策，切实减少温室气体排放。鉴于温室气体排放在大多数经济体中既普遍又多样，且各排放源之间的减排成本存在差异，统一的技术标准和绩效标准等传统环境政策方法不太可能足以完成这一任务。因此，人们越来越关注以碳定价机制为形式的市场化工具。我们考察了碳定价的主要选项——碳税、总量控制与交易、减排信用、清洁能源标准以及削减化石燃料补贴——所蕴含的机遇与挑战，并回顾了主要来自发达国家的实施经验。我们对相关理论的梳理以及对工业化国家经验的考察，可能有助于那些希望探讨碳定价在发展中国家适用性的人士。

title: The SO2 Allowance-Trading System and the Clean Air Act Amendments of 1990: Reflections on 20 Years of Policy Innovation
abstract: The introduction of the U.S. SO2 allowance-trading program to address the threat of acid rain as part of the Clean Air Act Amendments of 1990 is a landmark event in the history of environmental regulation. The program was a great success by almost all measures. This paper, which draws upon a research workshop and a policy roundtable held at Harvard in May 2011, investigates critically the design, enactment, implementation, performance, and implications of this path-breaking application of economic thinking to environmental regulation. Ironically, cap and trade seems especially well suited to addressing the problem of climate change, in that emitted greenhouse gases are evenly distributed throughout the world’s atmosphere. Recent hostility toward cap and trade in debates about U.S. climate legislation may reflect the broader political environment of the climate debate more than the substantive merits of market-based regulation.
abstract_zh: 美国二氧化硫排放权交易计划是《1990年清洁空气法修正案》为应对酸雨威胁而引入的，是环境监管史上的里程碑事件。该计划在几乎所有指标上都堪称巨大成功。本文依托2011年5月在哈佛大学举办的一场研究研讨会和一场政策圆桌会议，批判性地考察了这一将经济学思维运用于环境监管的开创性实践的设计、立法、实施、绩效及其影响。具有讽刺意味的是，总量控制与交易似乎尤其适合解决气候变化问题，因为温室气体在全球大气中分布均匀。近期美国气候立法辩论中对总量控制与交易的敌视，或许更多地反映了气候辩论的整体政治环境，而非市场化监管本身的实质优点。

title: Three Key Elements of a Post-2012 International Climate Policy Architecture
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy, 6(1): 65-85
abstract: This article describes three essential elements of an effective post-2012 international climate policy architecture: a framework to ensure that key industrialized and developing nations are involved in differentiated but meaningful ways, an emphasis on an extended time path for emissions targets, and the inclusion of flexible market-based policy instruments to keep costs down and facilitate international equity. This overall architecture is consistent with fundamental aspects of the science, economics, and politics of global climate change; addresses specific shortcomings of the Kyoto Protocol; and builds on the foundation of the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change.
abstract_zh: 本文阐述了有效的2012年后国际气候政策架构的三个关键要素：一是建立框架，确保主要工业化国家和发展中国家以有区别但有意义的方式参与其中；二是强调排放目标应采用延长的时间路径；三是纳入灵活的市场化政策工具，以控制成本并促进国际公平。这一总体架构与全球气候变化在科学、经济和政治方面的基本特征相一致，回应了《京都议定书》的具体不足，并以《联合国气候变化框架公约》为基础。

title: Using the Market to Address Climate Change: Insights from Theory & Experience
abstract: Emissions of greenhouse gases linked with global climate change are affected by diverse aspects of economic activity, including individual consumption, business investment, and government spending. An effective climate policy will have to modify the decision calculus for these activities in the direction of more efficient generation and use of energy, lower carbon-intensity of energy, and a more carbon-lean economy. The only technically feasible and cost-effective approach to achieving this goal on a meaningful scale is carbon pricing: that is, market-based climate policies that place a shadow-price on carbon dioxide emissions. We examine alternative designs of three such instruments: carbon taxes, cap and trade, and clean energy standards. We note that the U.S. political response to possible market-based approaches to climate policy has been, and will continue to be, largely a function of issues and structural factors that transcend the scope of environmental and climate policy.
abstract_zh: 与全球气候变化相关的温室气体排放，受到经济活动诸多方面的影响，包括个人消费、企业投资和政府支出。有效的气候政策必须改变这些活动的决策计算，使能源的生产和使用更加高效，降低能源的碳强度，并推动经济向低碳方向转型。要在有意义的规模上实现这一目标，唯一在技术上可行且具有成本效益的途径是碳定价，即通过对二氧化碳排放设定影子价格的市场化气候政策。我们考察了三种此类工具的替代设计：碳税、总量控制与交易，以及清洁能源标准。我们指出，美国对市场化气候政策方案的政治反应过去一直、将来也将继续主要取决于超出环境与气候政策范围的议题和结构性因素。

title: Climate Negotiations Open a Window: Key Implications of the Durban Platform for Enhanced Action
venue: Harvard Project on Climate Agreements policy brief [F-30]
abstract: A key outcome of the Seventeenth Conference of the Parties (COP-17) of the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC), held in Durban, South Africa, late in 2011 — the Durban Platform for Enhanced Action — represents an important milestone in the history of climate negotiations. This is because it departs from the long-standing and problematic dichotomous division of the world’s countries into those with serious emissions-reduction responsibilities and the others — with no such responsibilities whatsoever. That distinction, now apparently abandoned, has prevented meaningful progress for decades. The Durban Platform — by replacing the Berlin Mandate’s (1995) division of the world into a set of countries with ambitious responsibilities and another set of countries with no responsibilities — has opened an important window. National delegations from around the world now have a challenging task before them: to identify a new international climate policy architecture that is consistent with the process, pathway, and principles laid out in the Durban Platform, while still being consistent with the UNFCCC. The challenge is to find a way to include all key countries in a structure that brings about meaningful emission reduction on an appropriate timetable at acceptable cost, while recognizing the different circumstances of countries in a way that is more subtle, more sophisticated, and — most important — more effective than the dichotomous distinction of years past.
abstract_zh: 2011年末在南非德班召开的《联合国气候变化框架公约》第十七次缔约方大会（COP-17）的一项核心成果——《德班强化行动平台》——是气候谈判历史上的一个重要里程碑。这是因为它摆脱了长期以来将世界各国二分为承担严格减排责任的国家与完全不承担任何此类责任的国家的做法，而这种做法存在诸多问题。这一区分如今已被弃用，它在数十年间一直阻碍着实质性进展。《德班平台》以取代1995年《柏林授权》将世界划分为承担雄心勃勃责任的一组国家与不承担任何责任的另一组国家的做法，打开了一扇重要的窗口。世界各国代表团如今面临一项艰巨的任务：在符合《德班平台》所确立的进程、路径和原则，同时仍与《联合国气候变化框架公约》保持一致的前提下，确定新的国际气候政策架构。挑战在于找到一种方式，将所有关键国家纳入一个结构之中，以可接受的成本、在适当的时间表上实现有意义的减排；同时，这一结构应以比过去的二分法更为细致、更为复杂、尤其是更为有效的方式，承认各国的不同情况。

title: Challenges from State-Federal Interactions in US Climate Change Policy
abstract: With a focus on two sorts of regulation—renewable electricity and clean energy standards, and automobile fuel-economy standards—we analyze problematic interactions that arise when state policies are nested within the domain of Federal policy. Here state efforts may fail to reduce greenhouse gas emissions nationally, and may compromise cost-effectiveness. Difficulties from overlapping regulations are avoidable through price- (as opposed to quantity-) based Federal policy. We identify some potentially positive interactions between state and Federal policies, and identify rationales for state action when Federal and state policies do not overlap.
abstract_zh: 我们聚焦于两类监管——可再生电力与清洁能源标准，以及汽车燃油经济性标准——分析了州政策嵌套于联邦政策框架之内时产生的问题性互动。在这种情形下，州级努力可能无法在全国范围内减少温室气体排放，并可能损害成本效益。由政策交叠所带来的困难，可以通过以价格（而非数量）为基础的联邦政策加以避免。我们也指出了州政策与联邦政策之间某些潜在的积极互动，并阐明了在联邦政策与州政策不交叠的情况下，州级行动的理由。

title: The Effect of Allowance Allocations on Cap-and-Trade System Performance
venue: Journal of Law and Economics, 54(4): S267-S294
abstract: An implication of the Coase theorem is that under certain conditions, the market equilibrium in a cap-and-trade system will be cost-effective and independent of the initial allocation of tradable rights. That is, the overall cost of achieving a given aggregate emission reduction will be minimized, and the final allocation of permits will be independent of the initial allocation. We call this the independence property. This property is important because it means that the government can establish the overall pollution reduction goal for a cap-and-trade system by setting the cap and leaving it up to the legislature to construct a constituency in support of the program by allocating the allowances to various interests without affecting either the environmental performance of the system or its aggregate social costs. We examine the conditions under which the independence property is likely to hold—both in theory and in practice.
abstract_zh: 科斯定理的一个推论是，在特定条件下，总量控制与交易体系的市场均衡将具有成本效益，并且与可交易权利的初始分配无关。也就是说，实现给定总体排放削减的整体成本将被最小化，最终的排放权分配也将独立于初始分配。我们称之为独立性质。这一性质十分重要，因为它意味着政府可以通过设定排放上限来确定总量控制与交易体系的总体污染削减目标，并将排放权分配给各类利益群体，以在立法机构中构建支持该计划的选民基础，而不会影响体系的环境绩效或其总体社会成本。我们在理论和实践中考察了独立性质可能成立的条件。

title: The Problem of the Commons: Still Unsettled After 100 Years
The Value of Terroir: Hedonic Estimation of Vineyard Sale Prices
What Is the Value of Terroir?
Corporate Social Responsibility, Business Strategy, and the Environment
abstract: We examine the concept of firms sacrificing profits in the social interest within the environmental realm, with particular focus on the case of the United States by addressing four key questions. May they do so within the scope of their fiduciary responsibilities to their shareholders? Can they do so on a sustainable basis, or will the forces of a competitive marketplace render such efforts and their impacts transient at best? Do firms, in fact, frequently or at least sometimes behave this way, reducing their earnings by voluntarily engaging in environmental stewardship? Should firms carry out such profit-sacrificing activities (i.e. is this an efficient use of social resources)? We address these questions through the lens of economics, including insights from legal and business scholarship.
abstract_zh: 我们考察企业在环境领域为社会利益牺牲利润的概念，以美国为重点，围绕四个关键问题展开。第一，企业能否在其对股东的信托责任范围内这样做？第二，它们能否以可持续的方式这样做，还是竞争性市场的力量会使此类努力及其影响至多只是昙花一现？第三，企业实际上是否经常或至少有时会如此行事，即通过自愿履行环境管理职责而减少自身收益？第四，企业是否应当开展此类牺牲利润的活动（即这是否为对社会资源的有效利用）？我们从经济学视角出发，并结合法学和商学研究的见解来探讨这些问题。

title: Options for the Institutional Venue for International Climate Negotiations
venue: Council on Foreign Relations issue brief [F-26]
abstract: It is exceptionally challenging to conclude a comprehensive and effective multilateral agreement to address global climate change among nations with divergent interests. This is true for many international issues. However, largely because any domestic policy or set of policies to mitigate greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions (whether intended to implement an international agreement or not) extend so deeply into the economic fabric of a nation, climate change negotiations have proven to be exceptionally difficult. The Fifteenth Conference of the Parties (COP-15) of the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) reinforced doubts about whether the UNFCCC should continue to be the primary institutional venue for global climate change negotiations. This issue brief assesses some other institutions that might serve to supplement or partially replace the UNFCCC.
abstract_zh: 在各国利益分歧巨大的情况下，要就应对全球气候变化达成一项全面而有效的多边协议，极具挑战性。国际事务中的许多议题都是如此。然而，很大程度上由于任何旨在减少温室气体（GHG）排放的国内政策或政策组合（无论是否为执行某项国际协议而制定）都深入一国经济的肌理之中，气候变化谈判被证明异常困难。《联合国气候变化框架公约》（UNFCCC）第十五次缔约方大会（COP-15）加深了人们的疑虑，即《框架公约》是否仍应作为全球气候变化谈判的主要机构平台。本期政策简报评估了可能用以补充或部分替代《框架公约》的其他机构。

title: Comparing Price and Nonprice Approaches to Urban Water Conservation
abstract: Urban water conservation is typically achieved through prescriptive regulations, including the rationing of water for particular uses and requirements for the installation of particular technologies. A significant shift has occurred in pollution control regulations toward market‐based policies in recent decades. We offer an analysis of the relative merits of market‐based and prescriptive approaches to water conservation, where prices have rarely been used to allocate scarce supplies. The analysis emphasizes the emerging theoretical and empirical evidence that using prices to manage water demand is more cost effective than implementing nonprice conservation programs, similar to results for pollution control in earlier decades. Price‐based approaches may also compare favorably to prescriptive approaches in terms of monitoring and enforcement. Neither policy instrument has an inherent advantage over the other in terms of predictability and equity. As in any policy context, political considerations are also important.
abstract_zh: 城市节水通常通过规定性监管来实现，包括对特定用途的用水进行配给，以及要求安装特定技术。近几十年来，污染控制监管发生了显著转变，逐步转向市场化政策。我们对节水的市场化方法与规定性方法的相对优点进行了分析，而在水资源配置中，价格很少被使用。分析强调，新兴的理论与实证证据表明，与非价格节水计划相比，利用价格来管理用水需求更具成本效益，这与前几十年污染控制领域的结果相似。在监测与执行方面，基于价格的方法相较规定性方法也可能更具优势。就可预测性和公平性而言，两种政策工具都不具有内在优势。与任何政策情境一样，政治考量同样重要。

title: A Portfolio of Domestic Commitments: Implementing Common but Differentiated Responsibilities
venue: Harvard Project on Climate Agreements viewpoint [F-25]
abstract: International negotiations are focused on developing a climate policy framework for the post-2012 period, when the Kyoto Protocol’s first commitment period will have ended. In addition to negotiations under the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC), other intergovernmental outlets, including the G20 and the Major Economies Forum, are trying to reach common ground among the world’s major emitters of greenhouse gases. To date, these efforts have not produced a politically, economically, and environmentally viable structure for a future climate agreement. An effective, but more flexible and politically palatable approach could be an international agreement on a "portfolio of domestic commitments." Under such an agreement, nations would agree to honor commitments to greenhouse gas emission reductions laid out in their own domestic laws and regulations. A portfolio of commitments may emerge from a global meeting such as the UNFCCC Conference of the Parties, or a smaller number of major economies could negotiate an agreement among themselves, and then invite other countries to join. Despite the obvious differences between such a system and the conventional "targets and timetables" in the Kyoto Protocol, negotiators should not dismiss this new approach out of hand. There are several ways to construct a portfolio of domestic commitments, and negotiators have numerous levers available to tailor an agreement to meet their political, economic, and environmental goals. This Viewpoint outlines some basic features of a portfolio approach, highlights a few major issues and concerns, and discusses the potential feasibility of this approach.
abstract_zh: 国际谈判的焦点是为2012年后时期制定气候政策框架，届时《京都议定书》的第一承诺期将告结束。除《联合国气候变化框架公约》（UNFCCC）下的谈判外，二十国集团（G20）和主要经济体论坛（MEF）等其他政府间平台也在努力弥合世界主要温室气体排放国之间的分歧。迄今为止，这些努力尚未形成一种在政治、经济和环境上均可行的未来气候协议结构。一种更为灵活、在政治上更易被接受的做法，可能是缔结一项关于“国内承诺组合”的国际协议。在此类协议下，各国将承诺履行其国内法律法规中规定的温室气体减排承诺。一个承诺组合可以从《联合国气候变化框架公约》缔约方大会等全球性会议中产生，也可以由少数主要经济体先行相互谈判，再邀请其他国家加入。尽管此类体系与《京都议定书》中传统的“目标与时间表”方式存在明显差异，谈判者也不应一概否定这一新方法。构建国内承诺组合的方式有多种，谈判者手中也有许多杠杆可用来调整协议，以实现其政治、经济和环境目标。本观点文章概述了组合方法的一些基本特征，重点讨论了若干主要问题与关切，并探讨了该方法的潜在可行性。

title: A Meaningful U.S. Cap-and-Trade System to Address Climate Change
abstract: There is growing impetus for a domestic U.S. climate policy that can provide meaningful reductions in emissions of CO2 and other greenhouse gases. In this article, I propose and analyze a scientifically sound, economically rational, and politically feasible approach for the United States to reduce its contributions to the increase in atmospheric concentrations of greenhouse gases. The proposal features an up-stream, economy-wide CO2 cap-and-trade system which implements a gradual trajectory of emissions reductions over time, and includes mechanisms to reduce cost uncertainty. I compare the proposed system with frequently discussed alternatives. In addition, I describe common objections to a cap-and-trade approach to the problem, and provide responses to these objections.
abstract_zh: 美国国内日益迫切地需要一项能够切实减少二氧化碳及其他温室气体排放的气候政策。本文中，我提出并分析了一种科学上稳健、经济上合理、政治上可行的方案，供美国减少其对大气温室气体浓度上升所做的贡献。该方案的核心是一个上游的、覆盖整个经济体的二氧化碳总量控制与交易体系，它按照逐步推进的路径实现排放削减，并包含降低成本不确定性的机制。我将所提出的体系与常被讨论的替代方案进行了比较。此外，我还描述了针对总量控制与交易方法的常见反对意见，并对这些意见作出了回应。

title: Addressing Climate Change with a Comprehensive US Cap-and-Trade System
abstract: There is growing impetus for a domestic US climate policy that can provide meaningful reductions in emissions of carbon dioxide (CO2) and other greenhouse gases. I describe and analyse an up-stream, economy-wide CO2 cap-and-trade system which implements a gradual trajectory of emissions reductions (with inclusion over time of non-CO2 greenhouse gases), and includes mechanisms to reduce cost uncertainty. Initially, half of the allowances are allocated through auction and half through free distribution, with the share being auctioned gradually increasing to 100 per cent over 25 years. The system provides for linkage with emission-reduction credit projects in other countries, harmonization over time with effective cap-and-trade systems in other countries and regions, and appropriate linkage with actions taken in other countries, in order to establish a level playing field among domestically produced and imported products.
abstract_zh: 美国国内日益迫切地需要一项能够切实减少二氧化碳（CO2）及其他温室气体排放的美国气候政策。我描述并分析了一种上游的、覆盖整个经济体的二氧化碳总量控制与交易体系，它按照逐步推进的减排路径实施（非二氧化碳温室气体将随时间逐步纳入），并包含降低成本不确定性的机制。最初，一半的排放配额通过拍卖分配，一半通过免费发放分配，拍卖配额的比例将在25年内逐步提高至100%。该体系规定了与其他国家减排信用项目的衔接，随时间推移与其他国家和地区有效的总量控制与交易体系相协调，并与其他国家所采取行动适当挂钩，从而在国内生产的产品与进口产品之间建立公平的竞争环境。
